Outsole resistance to fuel oil (FO) - Yes xii. Sizes: 5,6,7,8,9,10,11 and 12

Vamp Lining Material – Textile vi. Quarter Lining – Yes vii. Quarter Lining Material – Textile Colour:- Upper – Fly knit fabric upper with black and red colour print or black and orange print or equallent Generic:- i. Insole provided – yes (Material Non-Woven Insole, oil, Mild Acid) ii. In socks type – Full In socks Removable and water permeable (Antifatigue molded EVA/PU insocks lamin ated with soft black netlon fabric for better cushioning). iii. Material of Tongue - Coated Fabric iv. Toe – Made from Fibre/Composite toe cap 200+4J v. Performance resistance insert type - Non-Metallic Outsole:- i. Outsole Design – Cleated outsole with wider cleats ii. Construction of Outsole – Double density sole EVA/ Nitrile rubber iii. Flexibility - Non Rigid iv. Material of Outsole - Polyurethane Lacing/Closing Of Shoes:- i. Closing (Tieing) mechanism - Laces ii. Laces – Polyester iii. Eyelets (Pairs) – 4 Pairs Certification/Test Report:- i. Standard ISI marked as per E N ISO 20345: 2022, Conforms to IS 15298 (Part-2): iii. BIS Certification – Yes iv. Warranty: 12 months for any genuine manufacturing defects. Warranty certificate for each lot of supply . v. Test certificate: Firms shall submit BIS certificate authorizing the firm to mark IS 15298 Part-2: vi. Test report: Firm shall give a manufacturer's test certificate while executing supplies. Standard ISI mark ed as per as per EN ISO 20345: 2022 And is IS 15298 (Part-02):2016: Protection Level: S1 : Design-A or latest Certificate. vii. The Bidder shall have to provide a sample shoe's of each size before the execution of supply to ascertai n the actual size of shoe of employee. Since, the sizes are getting varies brand to brand. viii. Defects: The supplier shall have to replace the shoe if any damaged is observed during the warranty/ gu aranty period.

ix. Packing Individual box packing with carry bag and 10 such boxes in a carton Documents to be submitte d while execution of supply. x. Approx. 850 gm /Pair xi. The safety shoes should be manufactured no more than 3 months before its supply. B) Terms & conditions: 1. The size of safety shoes should meet the requirement of standard IS 15298 (Part 2) S1 latest 2. The safety shoes Sizes to be given to successful bidder by IGMH after placing the order. After that firm will start the Manufacturing. 3. The quality of safety shoes should be ensured by the warranty period of 1 year. 4. The supplier of safety shoes labelling, Make, Model, Manufacture Year, IS Standard and CE marking. The se Standards are mandatory above Product, and Standards Certificate and test Certificates are required. 5. Test report: (Mandatory) Firm shall give a manufacturer's test certificate while executing supplies. Confo rming to IS: 15298 Part-2 S1 latest test report of safety shoe at the time of execution of supply and safety shoe shall be tested from AHSP/NABL/ILAC accredited or central Government Lab based on the test report material shall be accepted. Test shall have to be carried out as per IS 15298 (Part-2):S1. 6. Packing Standard each pair packed in individual shoe box & 10 such boxes in a multiply carton. 7. In addition to tender the supplier should submit the following i) Copy of the certificate of footwear manufacturers’ quality management system according to standard of ISO 9001:2015(or equivalent) ii) Copy of the certificate of EC-type test of the notified body certifying that the supplied safety shoes meet s the requirement of the national standard EN-ISO 20345:2022 iii) The bidder should enclosed catalogue or photo copy of offered product in technical bid along with its te chnical specifications. C)Payment Terms: 100% Payment will be made within 30 days after receipt and acceptance by IGMH. D) Eligibility Criteria: The bidder firm should meet following eligibility criteria to qualify: (a) For MSE/Start-up firm: Capability - Equipment & Manufacturing Facilities: The bidder firm should have c apability to manufacture and supply of tendered item. (b) For other firm - Experience and past performance: The bidder firm may be Manufacturer/ Proven suppli er/Authorized dealer or distributor of tendered item or bidder may participate with manufacturing authoriz ation form (issued by manufacturer of tendered item). Participating bidder needs to submit all the related documents along with the bid. Note: The Bidder should submit duly signed and stamped copy of bid document as a token of acceptance of all th e terms and conditions of the tender .
